title: Hit Scheduler
text: Schedule major time steps for variable-step solver, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough; {Output type} sets the type of block, {Initial buffer size} sets the initial size of buffer for scheduled time and {Use fixed buffer size} sets the option to use fixed-size buffer. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: En
ports.summary: Enable signal for scheduling time step scalar | vector

ports.name: Δt
ports.summary: Interval between current simulation time and time step to schedule scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Indication of scheduled time step scalar | vector

params.name: Output type
params.values: Type of block output Signal (default) | Function Call

params.name: Initial buffer size
params.values: Initial size of buffer for scheduled time steps 256 (default) | integer

params.name: Use fixed buffer size
params.values: Option to use fixed-size buffer off (default) | on
